title: Ndzingo Wa Moya Lowu Pfumelelaka
intro: Moya-xiviri wu yima hi nkarhi wa ndzingo wa Xikwembu, wu lava nkongomiso hi ku phikelela loku titsongahataka. Loyi a tivaka hinkwaswo u fularhela mulavi loyi, ntsena ku paluxa endzhaku leswaku lowu a ku ri ndzingo wa mbilu. Hi ku cincana loku loku nga twisisekiki, dyondzo malunghana ni vutlhari bya Xikwembu yi humelela emahlweni ka lava anakanyisisaka. Xana u nga yi vona nhlayo leyi hi ku ya hi xitlhokovetselo xa Quranic?
clues: Ndzi lave vutivi ni nkongomiso eka murhumiwa la rhandzekaka wa Allah
Ndzi tile ndzi lava ntiyiso, ndzi vitana Muprofeta hi ku navela lokukulu
Ndzi tshinyiwe kutani ndzi fularhela, hikuva vutlhari bya Allah a byi ri ni makungu man’wana ya nkarhi wolowo
Hambi swi ri tano a ndzi heleriwanga hi ntshembo—ematshan’weni ya sweswo, ndzi tshikilele emahlweni eku laveni ka mina
Loyi a tivaka hinkwaswo u tivise leswaku leswi a ku ri ndzingo wa mbilu ni xilemukiso
A ndzi ri exikarhi ka lava Quran yi paluxaka ha vona: ‘U rhurhumerile kutani a fularhela, hikuva ku tile eka yena wanuna la feke mahlo’.

options: Mukanganyisi Loyi A Lavaka Ku kanakana

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: Ku tshinyiwa hi Muprofeta Muhammad hi nkarhi wa xikhongelo
Ku ringiwa hi dyandza na ndlala eMakkah
Ku tlheriseriwa endzhaku etinyangweni ta paradeyisi
Ku ariwa hi vanhu va munhu hi xiyexe hikwalaho ka ripfumelo
Ku ringiwa hi rifuwo na vana
trial.answer: Ku tshinyiwa hi Muprofeta Muhammad hi nkarhi wa xikhongelo

location.label: Xiphemu xa Nkoka

Ehenhla ka Ntshava ya Safa hi nkarhi wa nimixo

location.answer: Emahlweni ka Muprofeta hi nkarhi wa ku hlaya

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: Mulavi u dlayiwile hi Quraysh hikwalaho ka ripfumelo
Xiendlakalo lexi xi rhekhodiwile tanihi ndzingo na dyondzo eka Ummah
Muhloti u ve munghana ni murhangeri
Rifuwo ra mulavi ri andzisiwe ka khume
Muhloti u tlhelele a nga tshembi
outcome.answer: Xiendlakalo lexi xi rhekhodiwile tanihi ndzingo na dyondzo eka Ummah
